• Portfolio Development & Business Growth     
• Develop and expand the company's product portfolio within specialty chemicals.   
• Identify new products, suppliers and market opportunities based on customer needs and market developments.   
• Build business cases for new product groups and assess their commercial potential.   
• Leverage your existing industry network to establish new supplier relationships and unlock additional business opportunities.   
• Proactively identify opportunities to expand the company's market presence and generate additional revenue.      
• Strategic Procurement & Supplier Management     
• Develop and execute procurement strategies aligned with the company's growth ambitions.   
• Build and maintain long-term relationships with international suppliers.   
• Lead commercial negotiations on pricing, payment terms, delivery conditions and contractual agreements.   
• Monitor global raw material markets, pricing trends and supply risks.   
• Identify alternative suppliers and products to improve competitiveness and supply reliability.      
• Commercial & Financial Management     
• Work closely with Sales to identify customer needs and translate these into portfolio opportunities.   
• Monitor purchasing costs and market developments and translate these into competitive selling prices.   
• Set and review monthly sales price levels for different products.   
• Identify opportunities to improve gross margins and overall profitability.   
• Contribute to the development of new business through strong supplier and market relationships.      
• Operational & Supply Chain Management     
• Oversee purchasing activities and ensure timely replenishment of inventory.   
• Balance stock availability, customer service levels and working capital.   
• Monitor supplier lead times and delivery performance.   
• Support demand forecasting and inventory optimization.   
• Drive continuous improvement in procurement processes and reporting.     
  
• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Supply Chain, Business, Engineering, Chemistry or equivalent experience.  
• 5–10 years of experience in procurement, sourcing or portfolio management.  
• Strong experience in the chemical industry and an established network of contacts within this industry, with the ability to leverage these relationships to create new business opportunities.  
• Proven experience in international supplier management and commercial negotiations.  
• Strong strategic, commercial and analytical skills, with a good understanding of pricing, margins and inventory management.  
• Hands-on, entrepreneurial and proactive mindset, with the ability to work independently.  
• Fluent in English; Dutch and/or French are a plus.

• Manage, maintain and optimize the IT infrastructure.

• Associate degree in ICT (Graduate).

Key Responsibilities

Project Procurement & Strategic Sourcing

• Develop and implement procurement strategies in collaboration with Project, Engineering and Commercial teams.
• Identify business requirements, potential suppliers and sourcing opportunities.
• Develop sourcing strategies and lead RFx / tendering processes.
• Prepare supplier consultations, analyze bids and develop sourcing recommendations.
• Lead negotiations on pricing, lead times, commercial and contractual terms and conditions.
• Identify cost reduction and value improvement opportunities throughout the procurement lifecycle.
• Develop Best-Cost Country Sourcing strategies, with a particular focus on Central and Eastern Europe.
Supplier Management

• Develop and maintain strong relationships with key strategic suppliers.
• Assess suppliers' capabilities, manufacturing capacity, geographical footprint and financial stability.
• Evaluate their ability to meet technical, quality and project schedule requirements.
• Contribute to supplier rationalization and supplier base development.
• Identify and resolve issues related to cost, quality, capacity, delivery and supplier performance.
• Work closely with Supplier Quality / Supplier Performance teams.
Contract & Change Management

• Lead the preparation and negotiation of supplier contracts.
• Manage supplier commitments following contract or purchase order award.
• Manage contractual changes, scope changes and claims.
• Assess the financial and contractual impact of changes and lead the associated negotiations.
• Ensure compliance with procurement procedures and applicable regulatory requirements.
• Work with Finance / Accounts Payable teams to resolve discrepancies between invoices and purchase orders.
Project Management

• Manage several procurement projects simultaneously in an international environment.
• Define action plans and monitor milestones, risks and expected benefits.
• Identify potential roadblocks and coordinate their resolution.
• Provide regular reporting to key stakeholders.
• Coordinate project changes and ensure alignment between the various functions and teams involved.
 

 

About You

You have significant experience in industrial procurement / project procurement, ideally gained within a technical and international environment.

We are looking for:

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Engineering, Procurement, Supply Chain, Business or a related field.
• 8+ years of experience in Procurement / Strategic Sourcing, ideally within an industrial environment.
• Significant experience managing complex projects.
• Strong knowledge of RFx, sourcing and supplier negotiations.
• Proven experience in Supplier Relationship Management (SRM).
• Solid experience in contract negotiation and Contract / Change Management.
• Experience in international sourcing, ideally with a good understanding of the EMEA supplier market.
• Experience sourcing from Central and Eastern Europe would be a strong advantage.
• Experience in Energy, Engineering, Heavy Industry, Automotive, Aerospace, Oil & Gas or other technically complex industries will be considered.
• Experience with SAP / SAP Ariba is an advantage.
• Good knowledge of Project Management tools and methodologies.
• Fluent English is essential due to the international environment.
• Willingness to travel internationally, up to approximately 30%.

Our client, a biotech company based in Zwijnaarde, is a global biotechnology firm bringing innovative CAR-T cell therapy to Ghent. With this, the company makes a daily difference in the lives of many patients suffering from cancer and other life-threatening diseases.They are currently in a phase of strong growth and are looking for motivated and dedicated team members.

Jobomschrijving

Are you ready for a new challenge where your expertise can truly make a difference?

If you have a Scientific degree and experience in Pharma, Life Sciences, Biotechnology, or related field, this is your opportunity to be part of something bigger than yourself. As an Operations Expert, you'll play a key role in manufacturing advanced cell therapies that are transforming cancer treatment and giving patients new hope.

Every day, your work will directly contribute to delivering life-changing therapies to patients facing serious diseases. Join a passionate team united by a shared purpose: creating innovative treatments and improving lives around the world.

Your key responsibilities:

• Work daily in a Class A/B/C/D cleanroom environment and maintain the cleanliness of equipment and facilities.
• Produce clinical and commercial ATMPs through aseptic manual processes, including cell isolation, selection, activation, transduction, culture, filling & finishing, and cryopreservation.
• Perform in-process control tests on batch samples, ensuring high standards for cell counts and viability.
• Ensure equipment operates smoothly by following instructions, troubleshooting issues, and coordinating repairs.
• Contribute to process optimization, including the introduction of new products, procedures, and equipment in GMP areas.
• Support the writing and review of SOPs and other production-related documents, and manage raw materials, consumables, and waste.

Who we are looking for:

• You have obtained at least a Bachelor's degree in Sciences, Bio-Engineering, Biotechnology, Pharmacy, or a related field, or possess equivalent experience.
• Cell experience (internship or work-based) is a strong plus. 
• Knowledge of GMP regulations is a strong plus.
• Strong interpersonal skills with a focus on teamwork are required.
• Clear communication in English with attention to detail.
• Strong problem-solving abilities with a positive attitude.
• Motivated to learn independently and coach others.
• Good knowledge of Microsoft Office applications.
